honors.title: Certificate of Distinction in Teaching
honors.description: This award - sponsored by the Derek Bok Center for Teaching and Learning in cooperation with the Office of the Dean of Undergraduate Education - reflects a Q score of 4.5 or higher in the "overall" category from 5 or more respondents for the Fall Semester 2016. The certificate acknowledges the excellence of your work with students and the strength of your commitment to teaching.
